subject: History
title: Early European printing spreads
prompt: Show three milestones in early European movable-type printing: Gutenberg's work in Mainz around 1450, the Gutenberg Bible around 1455, and a press in Paris in 1470. Avoid claiming Gutenberg invented all printing.
learner: No prior knowledge of printing history.
styleBrief: Editorial timeline with date anchors, small page illustrations, and progressive annotations.
criteria: Scope is early European movable-type printing, not the origin of printing worldwide.
Use approximate dates for Gutenberg's work and Bible.
Keep timeline positions proportional to dates.
